ACTION=A3
RATIONALE=The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (approx. 13.9 m/s) while approaching a much slower lead vehicle ahead at 3.8 m/s, located around 22 meters ahead. Since the closing speed is high and a collision is imminent unless action is taken, the appropriate maneuver to avoid a rear-end collision is to decelerate strongly.
